malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code exfiltrates system information to an external, attacker-controlled server and retrieves a token from a suspicious domain, which is a classic indicator of malware establishing C2 communication.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not send host information to unknown or unrelated servers, nor do they communicate with C2 infrastructure without user consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some packages may perform telemetry or update checks, but only to trusted vendor domains and never exfiltrate detailed system information.

Retrieval of execution token from a C2 endpoint (packages-api.test)
